purpose: Collect post-service feedback and satisfaction signals for internal review.
conditional_logic: Show Follow-up email only when Consent to follow up is selected.
confirmations: Thank submitter and state whether they should expect follow-up.
notifications: Send internal feedback notification to approved feedback owner only.
feeds: Survey Add-On result view only; optional CRM feed only after consent and add-on detection.
embedding_target: Post-service feedback page or private link.
data_retention_notes: Includes consent-dependent contact data. If anonymity is promised, do not collect email, user ID, CRM ID, or identifying hidden fields.

test_data.follow_up_case: Low score with consent to follow up

risks: Anonymity claim is invalid if contact or tracking fields are collected.
Summary result export may require entry export and external analysis.

spam_settings.recommended: Use layered spam protection appropriate for public feedback forms.

accessibility_settings.labels: Visible labels required. Scale choices need plain-language labels.
